Re: Tempus Fugit

Transposition:
X:1 has an augmented 7th in bar 4
where the
X:2 - X:4 versions put a diminished tonic.
The augmented 7th makes more sense since that is what the ear perceives and clearly indicates the use of the harmonic (minor) mode.

There are nice jazzy chords (°6, °9) and arpeggios and runs (4th bars!) in this lovely piece, inspired by the late Parisian musette style.
